summary: Practise evidence mapping, portfolio review and defensible RPL decisions. Explore the course and its applied assessment work.
lede: Assessment of prior learning for credentialing compares applicants’ existing knowledge and skills with defined competency requirements. For assessors, credentialing specialists and programme leads, the course practises mapping portfolio evidence, checking its validity, sufficiency, authenticity and currency, and designing challenge assessments when needed. You will also practise recording assessor reasoning, moderating decisions and reporting outcomes, linking each decision to the requirement and evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, administer or oversee prior-learning decisions for credentials and competency-based awards.
modules: RPL Evidence Mapping and Decision Rules
RPL Applicant Guidance and Evidence Integrity
prerequisites: Working familiarity with competency-based assessment or credentialing processes is expected. No coding is required.
